itens.resumo: Dr Ibrahim Sulu-Gambari, the 11th Emir of Ilorin, is among the finest of our nation’s traditional rulers—a distinguished Nigerian through and through. A lawyer and scholar, he rose to the peak of his legal career as a Justice of the Court of Appeal (Lagos Division) before ascending the throne of his forefathers. In the judiciary, […]
